# VISUAL_COURTS

All courts were rendered through the production `CinematicFrameRenderer`, encoded as nontrivial PNG files, dimension-checked, color-counted, and SHA-256 hashed. The first 180×300 court exposed a real viewport defect; the renderer was repaired and all courts reran successfully.

| Court | Dimensions | Colors | PNG bytes | SHA-256 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Head | 320×320 | 32 | 4,486 | `a5d1c4bac590d5cbe844e0bb0cc84061c937b5eab18f842bc4b37d6021d8099b` |
| Character | 180×300 | 28 | 2,956 | `6b2d5cae4bc673b56fb2f429b8adf4322389f6d6bc6c92e6d2cd5c3c71668d4b` |
| Half body | 512×512 | 34 | 6,507 | `c43812d0126669f065050f0bbf607140c0f99314231f2ded9493aebe31f2e88f` |
| Final trio | 1536×864 | 63 | 24,102 | `790b863d48887e378530e056f118173d3faa46dd8403eeb3bcfef381432e5a49` |

Representative 640×360 frames were also generated at 1,000; 5,000; 22,000; 36,000; 50,000; 55,000; and 58,500 milliseconds, with distinct raw and PNG hashes recorded in `visual-evidence.json`.

Browser production evidence from the complete verification suite also proved a nontrivial rendered scene frame and exported browser movie.
